Propose with a teddy who runs in holding a rose

Some questions deserve more than a text message. In a WishCraft proposal card, a nervous teddy runs in from the side holding a rose, your letter is written out line by line, your photos appear one by one, and then comes the big question. The “No” button keeps running away, and if they somehow find it, the teddy sits down and cries. When they say yes, the rose changes hands and both teddies run around happily before a hug.

Make a proposal card · ₹30

Preview it free. You only pay when you love it. Now ₹30, usually ₹35.

What’s in your proposal card

  • A boy or girl teddy that runs in with a rose, you choose who is who
  • A sealed envelope that opens to a handwritten-style letter
  • Your photos as polaroids, then your own question, for example “Will you marry me?”
  • A “No” button that runs away from fingers and mouse pointers
  • A heartbreak scene if they keep trying: sad teddy, broken heart, drooping rose
  • A celebration with the rose, fireworks, hearts and a hug

Message ideas you can borrow

From the very first day, something about you felt like home. You have seen my best and my worst, and you stayed. I cannot imagine a single future without you in it.
Every plan I make, you are already in it. Every good thing that happens, you are the first person I want to tell. So, here it is…
I wanted to ask this in a way you would never forget, so I made you this. Will you spend the rest of your life with me?

How it works

  1. Pick the moment and write your words. Add their name, your name, your message, and up to 5 photos if you like.
  2. Preview it for free. Watch the whole card, with sound, as many times as you want.
  3. Pay ₹30 and send the link. Pay with UPI, card, netbanking or wallet, then send the link on WhatsApp.

Questions

What happens if she (or he) presses No?

The No button runs away every time, so it can never really be pressed. Each attempt makes the proposing teddy sadder, until it sits down crying with a broken heart. Pressing Yes is the only way to finish.

Can a girl propose to a boy, or two people of the same gender?

Yes. You choose whether you are a boy or girl teddy, and whether they are. The one proposing runs in with the rose.

Is the proposal private?

Only people who have the link can open it, and the link is hard to guess. Search engines are told not to list it.
